name: Freestone County, TX
findings: Freestone County has 59 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Freestone County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Freestone County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 66% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
